title: Purpose in Christ
definition: Purpose in Christ means that every believer has meaning, value, calling, and usefulness because they belong to Jesus Christ.
summary: Purpose is found in Christ, not in worldly success, physical ability, or human recognition.
christFocus: Christ calls ordinary people, equips them through His Spirit, and uses them for His glory regardless of background, weakness, limitations, or past failures.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Many people search for purpose through success, achievements, wealth, status, health, or recognition. Scripture teaches that true purpose begins with knowing Christ. Every believer is called to glorify God, grow in faith, serve others, and participate in God's mission. Purpose is not reserved for the gifted, powerful, or healthy. God delights in using ordinary people who trust Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people feel forgotten, overlooked, disabled, disqualified, or unable to contribute. Understanding purpose in Christ reminds believers that their usefulness comes from God, not human ability or worldly success.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask God daily how you can serve Him where you are right now. Focus less on what you cannot do and more on what God has placed before you today. Trust that faithfulness in small things matters greatly in His kingdom.
